description: Bulk notification sent to all eligible students when the Student Union election administrator closes voting.
subject: Student Union voting has now closed
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is to let you know that voting in the Student Union election has now been closed by the Elections Committee.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Voting closed at:  $closed_at
Closed by:         $closed_by
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What happens next:
• No further votes can be cast in any open election from this point on.
• The Elections Committee will count and verify the votes.
• Results will be published once they have been confirmed.
• If you cast a vote before voting closed, it has been securely recorded and will be counted.

Thank you to everyone who participated.

Kind regards,
Student Union Elections Committee
University Administration

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
